text: This is what the Lord says: “Where is your mother’s certificate of divorce with which I sent her away? Or to which of my creditors did I sell you? Because of your sins you were sold; because of your transgressions your mother was sent away.

When I called, why was there no one to answer? Was my arm too short to ransom you? Do I lack the strength to rescue you? By a mere rebuke I dry up the sea, I turn rivers into a desert; their fish rot for lack of water and die of thirst.

I will not be disgraced. Therefore have I set my face like flint, and I know I will not be put to shame.
Who then will bring charges against me? Let us face each other! Who is my accuser? Let him confront me!
Who is he that will condemn me? They will all wear out like a garment; the moths will eat them up.
